description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul writes to Titus, whom he left in Crete to appoint elders in every town. He sets out what an elder must be and warns against rebellious teachers who must be silenced.
1.sw: Paulo anamwandikia Tito, aliyemwacha Krete ili awateue wazee katika kila mji. Anaeleza mzee anapaswa kuwa mtu wa namna gani na kuonya dhidi ya walimu waasi ambao lazima wanyamazishwe.
1.am: ጳውሎስ በየከተማው ሽማግሌዎችን እንዲሾም በቀርጤስ ለተወው ለቲቶ ይጽፋል። ሽማግሌ ምን ዓይነት ሰው መሆን እንዳለበት ይዘረዝራል፤ ዝም ሊሰኙ ስለሚገባቸው ዓመፀኛ አስተማሪዎችም ያስጠነቅቃል።

2.en: Titus is to teach older men and women, younger men and slaves to live in a way that fits sound teaching. The grace of God has appeared, training believers to live self-controlled lives as they wait for their blessed hope.
2.sw: Tito anapaswa kuwafundisha wanaume na wanawake wazee, vijana wa kiume na watumwa waishi kwa namna inayolingana na mafundisho sahihi. Neema ya Mungu imeonekana, ikiwafundisha waamini kuishi maisha ya kiasi wanapongojea tumaini lao lenye baraka.
2.am: ቲቶ ሽማግሌ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን፣ ወጣት ወንዶችንና ባሪያዎችን ከትክክለኛው ትምህርት ጋር በሚስማማ መንገድ እንዲኖሩ ሊያስተምር ይገባዋል። የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ተገልጧል፤ አማኞችም የተባረከውን ተስፋቸውን ሲጠባበቁ ራሳቸውን እየገዙ እንዲኖሩ ያሠለጥናቸዋል።

3.en: Believers are to submit to rulers and be gentle to everyone, for God saved them not because of works but by mercy, through the washing of rebirth and the Holy Spirit. Titus must avoid foolish controversies, and Paul closes with instructions and greetings.
3.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kuwatii watawala na kuwa wapole kwa kila mtu, kwa maana Mungu aliwaokoa si kwa sababu ya matendo bali kwa rehema, kupitia kuoshwa kunakoleta kuzaliwa upya na Roho Mtakatifu. Tito lazima aepuke mabishano ya kipumbavu, naye Paulo anamalizia kwa maagizo na salamu.
3.am: አማኞች ለገዦች ሊገዙና ለሰው ሁሉ ገሮች ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ያዳናቸው ከሥራ የተነሣ ሳይሆን በምሕረቱ፣ ዳግመኛ በሚያስወልደው መታጠብና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ነውና። ቲቶ ከሞኝነት ክርክሮች መራቅ አለበት፤ ጳውሎስም በመመሪያና በሰላምታ ይደመድማል።
